privacy.ai_training_note: Free and Pro users: AI training is enabled by default but users can opt-out via privacy settings. Teams, Business, Enterprise, and Education users: Content is NEVER used for AI training and cannot be opted in. Canva Creators receive payments for allowing templates to be used for AI training and can opt-out at any time.
privacy.data_region: Default: United States and Australia. Enterprise customers can choose to store data in US or EU regions. Data processed by Canva group members in Australia, New Zealand, Philippines, United Kingdom, Singapore, Europe, and United States. Hosted on AWS.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2 or higher for data transmitted over public networks between customers and Canva application

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES 256 or stronger for customer personal data stored on Canva servers

security.name: Infrastructure hosting
security.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS) data centers with AWS physical, environmental, and infrastructure controls

security.name: ISMS
security.value: ISO 27001-compliant Information Security Management System with internal audit program and management committee oversight
